inputs.title: Kato finite Selmer theorem at noncentral critical twists
inputs.scope: Normalized newform of weightk>=2,finite abelian L/Q,every finite eigenvalue-field place lambda,stable lattice in V_f(r),1<=r<=k-1,2r!=k. Finite discrete BK Selmer group. CM included; no ordinary or prime-size hypothesis.
inputs.application: KTR2:k=2e+1,r=e. KTR1 converts finite discrete Selmer to rational zero.

inputs.title: Quadratic GL2 base change
inputs.scope: Cuspidal automorphic representation over a characteristic-zero number field,cyclic quadratic extension. Cuspidal lift unless induced from a character of that extension; local lifting at all places and normalized spherical roots raised to residue degree. Unitary application then norm twist.
inputs.application: KTR9:the exceptional induced/selftwist case contradicts irreducibility of the actual W on G_K. Archimedean weight and q^(1/2) normalization checked.

inputs.title: Polarized Galois attachment and adjoint Selmer vanishing
inputs.locator: BLGGT section2.1/Theorem2.1.1;Thorne Theorem6.1;full polarized adjoint definition in section2
inputs.scope: RA polarized cuspidal GL_n over CM field,normalized attachment,full infinite-cyclotomic irreducibility for adjoint vanishing. All n>=2 and every coefficient prime in these statements; full M_n adjoint,not tracezero.
inputs.application: Exact new rank2 application in KTR9-KTR10; inherited complete convention match ADK3-ADK6. Symmetric pairJ2, multiplier1 onG_K,disconnected action minus J2-transpose-J2.

inputs.title: Classical normalized newform adelization, eigenfield and multiplicity one
inputs.scope: Original normalized cusp eigenform,nebentype,newvector and fixed eigenvalue embedding; finite eigenvalue field; cuspidal adelization and strong multiplicity one.
inputs.application: Inherited actual RNC2 construction,source good-prime eigen/newness dictionary for Kato, and exact pi^0|det|^(1/2) normalization.

inputs.title: Global class-field theory
inputs.scope: For imaginary quadraticK,everywhere unramified abelian Galois quotient is its finite ideal class group; finite order characters and norm Hecke characters,quadratic sign correction,all at the original embeddings.
inputs.application: KTR5 kills residual-near1 characters using ell not dividinghK;KTR11 kills rational additive unramified characters;KTR9 makes the exact algebraic Hecke multiplier.

inputs.title: Local/global decomposition groups and cyclotomic inertia
inputs.scope: Completion realizes the decomposition subgroup from the given embedding; inertia comparison and equivariance of cyclotomic characters. Every rational ell-power cyclotomic local extension is totally ramified,so inertia surjects onto Z_ell^times.
inputs.application: KTR4 identifies the source local subgroup and produces the infinite-order and residual-generic elements;KTR8 uses full cyclotomic quotient.

inputs.title: Finite Galois cohomology and Bloch-Kato fundamental exact sequence
inputs.scope: Finite generation of H1(G_L,S,T) for a stable finite Z_ell lattice,finite-place Bloch-Kato fundamental sequence and Hf(Kv,E)=H1_unram(Kv,E) for trivial characteristic-zero coefficients.
inputs.application: Inherited DX1/BX7,with explicit bounded-lattice and class-group consumers inKTR1/KTR11.

inputs.title: Original tied Bcris period model
inputs.scope: The source Bcr model is the usual equivariant crystalline period ring with the original cyclotomic convention.
inputs.application: Inherited BX1/ADK5;all source graph and finite-coefficient local witness transport written inKTR1.

inputs.title: Standard finite-dimensional algebra and topology
inputs.scope: DVR reduction,prime-to-ell torsion,Schur lemma,finite-group averaging,finite tensor operations and continuous linear maps.
inputs.application: The relevant elementary uses are proved inKTR1/KTR3-KTR8/KTR12-KTR13.
